---
name: demo-script
description: Prepare a reproducible 60-second VenturaSec demo that proves one implemented defensive detection or triage capability on safe test data. Use when an executable MVP slice needs a concise demonstration. Do not use when the demo requires live offensive actions or sensitive operational data.

# Demo script

- Use a safe synthetic or authorized dataset fixture.
- Show the input event or batch and resulting anomaly alert or mitigation recommendation.
- State the metric threshold and known false-positive limitation.
- Keep the demo defensive and non-exploitative.
- Avoid claims of complete attack coverage.
- Verify the workflow from a clean checkout before publishing.
